nodes.name: Read latest_jobs.json
nodes.notes: Replace the URL with your repo's raw GitHub URL for data/latest_jobs.json. Only works if the repo is public, or add a GitHub auth credential.

nodes.name: IF score >= threshold
nodes.notes: Change the value2 threshold (default 75, matching the digest cutoff) to whatever you want n8n to alert on.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Message
nodes.notes: Set up a 'Telegram account' credential in n8n (Settings > Credentials) with your bot token, then select it here. chatId reads from an n8n environment variable TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID -- set one, or replace with a literal chat id.
